description: One memory shared by Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenClaw and 20 more coding agents, built from the session history already on disk. A fix found in one agent comes back in any of them, including months of sessions from before you installed it. No LLM, no embeddings, one local Go binary.
summary: Search your past AI coding sessions — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 17 more. Indexes the session history they already wrote to disk, including months from before you installed it, and recalls it in any of them. No LLM, no embeddings, one local Go binary.
